Reverting only that sentence made the test pass again (5/5). The finder ranks over the whole catalogue, so a description edit shifts term weights for every tool and can move a pair that was not touched across the confusability line. Consequence for anyone editing a description: the pair a failure names need not include the tool you changed; revert-and-rerun is the quick attribution.
